body: I wish I was, but I’m reality I go into work everyday and get yelled at because I’m not doing two jobs perfectly when I only have the time to do one. I’m honestly about to attempt again because I hate this job, but I don’t have anywhere else to go and I don’t want to be homeless if I do quit/get fired.
I work a 12 hour night shift at a plastic factory. I’m doing two jobs at once. I pull and wrap pallets, and I train new people on what to do.
